messages:
Lisa (Sales): Heads up — BlueHarbor Legal/Security asked for a compliance package for the POC: SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted ok), ISO27001 scope statement, pen-test attestation/letter, KMS/HSM keyflow diagram, network segmentation diagram, and audit-log retention details. They want the bundle by Fri EOD PST so procurement can sign the SOW. Any immediate blockers? @Jordan can you advise on POC flavor and pricing uplift?
Jordan (Sales SE): On it. Quick q — do they want Dedicated or Private for the POC? They mentioned air-gapped in the call. Also need to know if we can offer a 30-day trial or any one-off credits.
Lisa (Sales): They prefer Private (VPC) for the POC. Budget conscious — need exact uplift and whether a trial is possible.
Kevin (Security): We can share a redacted SOC2 Type II attestation PDF and a redacted pen-test attestation summary once we have an NDA in place. Full control matrix and vendor pen-test report require an IP-protected request. Short answers: KMS rotation logs retained 365 days; HSM vendor is Thales; SSO via SAML (IdP metadata required).
Ryan (Infra Eng): :wave: For air-gapped/appliance on-prem we need ~3 weeks to prepare image + install guide. For Private/VPC POC we can pre-provision in ~48–72h after PO + subnets + allowed egress list.
Lisa (Sales): Can we stage a minimal evidence bundle early — send redacted SOC2 + pen-test attestation summary first, then full control matrix after legal clears? Customer agreed to that cadence.
Kevin (Security): Yes. I'll prepare the redacted SOC2 and a signed pen-test attestation (summary + date of last test and severity summary). Note: full pen-test report requires customer's PO + NDA with our 3rd-party vendor clause. I'll DM the NDA template.
sec-bot: Attachment uploaded: /evidence/redacted-soc2-blueharbor-2026.pdf
Jordan (Sales SE): Pricing check: Private POC flat setup fee + monthly lease — need exact numbers. @Maya can you confirm billing code and if we can apply a trial credit? Also want to know if the 30% uplift figure is acceptable for quoting.
Maya (Finance Ops): Billing code is POC-PRV-2026. Setup fee usually handled via SOW; invoice on kick. We can apply a one-time credit up to $5,000 for strategic POCs. I'll DM the full cost table.
Lisa (Sales): Kevin — confirm the sharing rules: is the redacted SOC2 link shareable with customer external counsel? We need pen-test attestation signed by CISO.
Kevin (Security): Confirmed: redacted SOC2 can be shared under NDA. I'll route the pen-test attestation to our CISO for signature — ETA ~48h.
Ryan (Infra Eng): For provisioning we need their subnet CIDRs, two public IPs for NAT, and firewall contact. Minimal config snippet they can paste: ```egress:
  - proto: tcp
    ports: [443, 80]
allowed_ips:
  - <customer_nat_ip>/32
``` Also we need AS number if they're doing BGP.
Lisa (Sales): I'll collect subnets and firewall contact today. One more ask — customer wants 12 months audit-log retention; can we commit in the SOW?
Ryan (Infra Eng): Default retention for Private is 13 months; we can lock to 12 months in SOW.
Lisa (Sales): Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll update BlueHarbor and circulate NDA + PO request. Will follow up once CISO signs pen-test attestation. :thumbsup:
